Shop.NoNpcSheet: This module's own dnd5e sheet couldn't be found for the NPC sheet button.

Closed.Label: Closed
Closed.Title: Shutters are down
Closed.Body: You can look over the goods. Nothing can be bought or sold until the shop opens.

Buy.AddToBill: Add to the bill of sale
Buy.Empty: This shop has nothing left to show here.

Sell.Empty: Nothing in your pack this shop has an opinion on yet.
Sell.TillHolds: The till holds {amount}, so no sale today can bring in more.

Reason.UnidentifiedNote: Unidentified. Get it looked at first.

Sell.ConfirmContained: {name} is inside another item. Sell it anyway?

Bill.Empty: Add goods to start a bill of sale.

Seal.StockChangedNotice: Stock changed while this bill was open. Prices below are current.
Seal.NoGmNotice: No GM is at the table. Trades are carried out by the GM's client. Your bill is kept: seal it again once one connects.
Seal.TillShortNotice: The till holds {amount}, less than this sale. Take lines off the bill until it fits.
Seal.TillShortBuyNotice: The till holds {amount} and can't make change for this. Pay closer to the sum, or take lines off.

Terms.Title: Terms of trade
Terms.ListPriceNote: The price in the book is the price you pay.
Terms.ExampleSells: A 15 gp item sells here for
Terms.ExampleBuys: A 15 gp item buys back here for
Terms.Note: Set by the GM on the shop. Prices below already include these terms.

BuyerPicker.PlayerHint: Only actors you own. The assigned character is the default.
BuyerPicker.GmHint: Any actor. Coins come from, and goods go to, whoever is picked.

Settings.SaveFailed: That change wasn't saved: Foundry refused the update. The console has the details.
Settings.Broken: This shop's settings can't be read (a 1.x merchant not yet migrated, or a hand edit), so the tab won't write over them. Reload to migrate it, or fix its flags.

Visit.Label: Players can visit
Visit.Hint: Off hides the shop from players, except any you gave their own access to it.
Visit.Others: Players with their own access: {count}. Change it in the shop's Ownership.

Terms.Hint: Rates apply to every item unless a category rule says otherwise.

Rules.Title: Category rules
Rules.None: None. Every category trades at the rates above.
Rules.Category: Category to add a rule for

Deals.Later: Special prices for one character come with deals (#111).

WontBuy.Hint: The shop refuses to buy anything of these types or kinds. Its shopkeeper's own gear is never for sale.

Hours.Hint: Closes to players outside these hours, on the world clock. A close before the open runs past midnight.
Hours.WorldOff: Trading hours are off for the whole world (Configure Settings), so every shop is open around the clock.

Restock.Hint: Restocking draws the shelf from the stock table and refills the till.
Restock.WorldOff: Scheduled restocks are off for the whole world (Configure Settings); Restock now still works.
Restock.NoTable: This shop has no stock table, so it can't restock.
Restock.RerollHint: Everything the table drew is drawn again at fresh quantities. Goods you added by hand stay.
Restock.TopupHint: Only drawn goods that sold out come back. Goods you added by hand stay.
Restock.Till: Either way, the till is refilled to {gp} gp.
Restock.Failed: The shop couldn't restock: its stock table, or some of the goods on it, couldn't be found. The console of the GM tab that runs trades says which.
Restock.NoAnswer: No answer yet from the GM tab that runs trades. The restock may be waiting behind others and still run; check the shelf in a moment.

Reset.Label: Reset to preset
Reset.Title: Reset to preset
Reset.Question: Put back the terms, hours, won't-buy and restock this shop was imported with? Its goods and coin stay as they are.
Reset.NoPreset: This shop's preset merchant can't be found.

Preview.Title: Players see
Preview.Note: Open shop windows refresh for everyone when a change is saved.
